# looker_group (Data Source)

Looks up a Looker group by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "looker_group" "example" {
  name = "Analysts"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the group. Matched case-insensitively.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
